root_cause: Generic trusted-advisor longform editorial policy was applied to personal B2B outreach; deterministic quality allowed role-only context and leakage of analysis labels, and the plain-text sender lacked official company signature.
prevention: verified real conversation or LinkedIn link from source export
real business relevance without invented pain
reject AI editorial labels and internal signatures
recheck copy at original sender before provider claim
LinkedIn relationship alone does not prove individual topical relevance; require independent fact or actual conversation before composing
Original Gmail sender requires independently documented e-mail opt-in or verified existing-customer soft opt-in on the exact CRM person; generic human approval is insufficient
Founder role segmentation only guides topic selection; no invented buyer problem, early meeting pressure or multiple questions
Only provider-verified replies, complaints, qualified meetings and paid orders prove real channel outcomes; evaluate one experimental variable at a time
For HTML email signature, use complete URL parsing and exact HTTPS host/path comparisons, never a substring-only domain assertion; protect against arbitrary host prefix/suffix.

prevention_rule: Human founder email requires a verified individual topic beyond first-degree LinkedIn membership; no fabricated buyer pain or pressuring meeting CTA. Original sender has independently proven recipient-specific commercial email authority, suppression, provider idempotence and readback. Generic CRM approvals do not establish legal authority. Source-based replies, optouts and separately confirmed revenue determine outcomes. Logo and website href acceptance must use complete URL parsing and exact allowlisted destination comparison, not partial URL matching.
